chapters.title: Chapter 1151: A Shameless Copy.
paragraphs: After a good beating to bring the senses of the daughter obsessed with her father back into place, Kassandra was lying on the floor with her butt up, burning, even though she was the personification of destruction, this power was sealed, and nothing would protect her from her mother’s beating.
Sniffling and with a crying tone, she spoke: "I will tell my father about this."
"You can tell your father whatever you want, and that won’t change anything." Kali spoke disdainfully: "Now, stop your nonsense and get up and behave like the Imperial Princess that you are."
Kassandra did not get up immediately; instead, she stopped sniffling and looked at her mother. Unlike before, her eyes were completely empty, like two violet black holes.
Kali shuddered slightly. Those eyes reminded her a lot of Victor when he became possessive of her.
"You really aren’t cheating on my father, right?"
"Of course not. Stop your nonsense. I love my husband and wouldn’t trade him for anyone." Kali replied seriously.
"Hmm." Kassandra simply stood up gracefully and lightly patted her butt to make the pain stop. "Good." She smiled gently, and her eyes returned to normal: "I would hate to hurt my mother."
"...." Kali put her hand on her forehead and sighed. She did not even try to argue because she knew very well that her daughter was serious now.

’This family has a serious problem... Well, it’s not like I didn’t know that.’ Kali thought. She knew very well what she was getting herself into when she decided to court her Husband. The problem was that she did not expect her daughters to become like this too, and some of them were even worse than Kassandra. Victor’s daughter with Kaguya, for example, was a completely shameless female version of her father. Yuno didn’t even hide her type of personality anymore, and to make matters worse, her father completely supported her. Kali began to feel a headache again, that familiar headache that all of Victor’s more rational wives had.
Putting that aside, she decided to return to business. Using her dragon powers, she returned to the throne room with her appearance completely intact. Neither she nor her daughter had changed at all.

"Sorry for the delay, let’s get back to the matters I came here for today." Kali, not wanting to waste any more time, decided to get straight to the point. After all, the longer she took, the more reasons Kassandra would probably have to find reasons to lose control.
"First of all, what do you think of my Husband’s announcement?"

"Understandable. If he is preparing for these beings, the more military forces he has, the better." On this matter, Shiva shared the same opinion as the Heavenly Father. He did not think that any competent ruler would disagree with Victor’s actions. He simply did not like being bound to Victor, even if it was a promise of protection. To Shiva, it seemed more like a collar.
"I understand." That answer was enough.

Kali did not even need to use her powers to read Shiva. She had known him for quite some time, and already had an idea of Shiva’s opinion on the matter, but this was something she did not care about. If the price of the Empire’s protection was having his soul bound to her husband, so be it. It was better than mutual destruction. Kali raised her hand and a red sphere was created.
"This is..." Shiva’s eyes narrowed.

"My knowledge, and Victor’s, about destruction, a complete report on the enemy forces." A gift similar to the one given to the Heavenly Father, but in the form of knowledge, and this was not, in any way, Victor being partial. It was simply that, for the current Shiva, more power in the divinity of destruction was useless.

He was stuck because he did not understand the concept of destruction itself. Therefore, the insights from Victor and Kali about destruction were much more valuable to him. With this item, he would be able to progress even further in his mastery of destruction. And the report on the enemies was something Victor had also given to the Heavenly Father. Since angels were different from gods, he did not need to give any knowledge about how to strengthen the gods. After all, the gods themselves already knew how to become stronger; they were simply too lazy. Victor gave them everything they needed most at that moment to progress; the rest was up to them.
"I understand... And the reason for such a gift is?" Even though he really wanted that knowledge about destruction, Shiva was not a fool.
"Strengthening our allies. The Heavenly Father and Amaterasu received the same treatment." Kali replied neutrally.

’Although Amaterasu’s treatment is much better than the other two, after all, she is my sister.’ Kali thought. In this regard, Victor was clearly very partial, but this was understandable; the other side was his wife, who had given him a daughter, and she had been his ally for the longest time.

Now that this thought had taken shape, the Dragon Goddess of destruction furtively looked at Shiva and thought: ’If I become the Goddess Queen of this pantheon, won’t the treatment improve even more?’ After thinking about this for a few seconds, she immediately discarded the idea. She had no patience to deal with fools, thank you very much. She had never been a very sociable goddess anyway. It was better not to get involved in problems that would only give her a headache and make her want to destroy everything.
"You will understand when you look at the actual battle report." With a gesture of her hand, Kali sent the sphere to Shiva.

Shiva looked attentively at the sphere for a few seconds, then took the sphere in his hand and absorbed the knowledge within it. For now, he ignored the knowledge about destruction and focused on the report.

"... Shit." Even he could not contain himself when he saw what had just happened. He would be able to survive that attack, but something told him that this was only a basic attack; therefore, in the worst-case scenario, that would not be the only attack he would suffer, and he was not very confident about taking attacks capable of destroying an entire solar system head-on several times.
The scale of this battle was ridiculous, and sacrificing an entire solar system, these enemies were crazy.
"Are all the enemies like this?" Shiva asked.
"Perhaps, we don’t know, but we are working under the assumption that they are all like this." Kali replied.
"The lowest level of the enemy, we categorize as CODE: V-03; they have the power to destroy entire continents, and these are only the lowest-level soldiers."
"If it’s only that level, it’s easy. The problem will be the elite."
"You don’t understand; there are billions of soldiers at this level. I repeat again: they are low-level soldiers, which means they are the enemy’s cannon fodder."
"... Well, damn." Even if many ants joined together, they would eventually bring down an elephant. After all, except for a few selected beings, not everyone had absurd amounts of energy.

"The enemies’ elites and strongest gods, we presume they will be at the level of CODE: V-06, beings capable of destroying entire galaxies, and we don’t know how many of them they have, but since they are factions that have existed for a long time... We are assuming that they will have a good stock of these forces."
"Damn, the situation is bad, huh."
’No wonder Victor is preparing so much; I would do the same if I had this information.’ He now regretted some decisions he had made recently. Shiva thought.
"We are preparing for the worst-case scenario, but we will only know what the situation is really like when the barrier falls."

Currently, sending spies to the upper sectors was very risky. The barrier between the sectors was already very thin and close to breaking. If Victor broke the barrier somewhere else to send spies, it was possible that the barrier would break completely.
It was as thin as the cheapest plastic now. It was the only available gate that led directly into enemy territory, where they were probably camped on the other side, waiting for the barrier to fall.
Despite this fragility existing only on Victor’s side, on the enemies’ side, the barrier remained as strong as ever.

For now, they were blind about the other side, but since Victor did not like working blindly, he positioned his heralds at the weakest locations. Any information they obtained was immediately transferred to the Empire. But Shiva did not need to know this yet. Giving incorrect information was dangerous for hundreds of other reasons.
While Kali and Shiva talked, Kassandra simply became one with the environment. She just stood there without moving like a truly exquisite and beautiful divine ornament.

’Boring, I hate this. When will my mother stop talking? Can I destroy this place? Why am I even here? Ah, politics. Boring... Father, I miss you.’ Her eyes scanned the place, and finding nothing useful or anything to do, she became even more bored.

Kassandra swore that she would never come back here again. She was not a very quiet person like almost all of Victor’s daughters, and standing here posing as a dignified Imperial Princess was very boring.

’This place seems very fragile. Even if I just increase my power a little, this entire dimension could collapse. Everyone here is ugly, my eyes are stained, I need to look at my father... My beautiful father...’ She created Victor’s appearance on his throne with her powers of destruction.
’I am getting better at this, fufufufu. Soon I will be able to make my father completely lose the power of destruction, fufufufu~’ She held herself back as much as possible from drooling.
’I wonder what my sisters are doing. I hope they are as bored as I am.’ Kassandra was petty when she was bored.

’Hmm?’ Kassandra narrowed her eyes when she sensed something, and then, without even warning her mother, she used her power to bend reality, appeared in front of a boy, and grabbed him by the neck. She returned to where she had been and threw him in front of Shiva and her mother.
"Ugh, what is this?" The boy was confused, but when he looked at his father, he immediately became silent. Even though he had done nothing, he knew he was screwed.
"What is this?" Kassandra asked while her eyes visibly darkened, her dragon eyes glowing with the pure power of destruction.
In front of Shiva and Kali was a boy who looked 50% to 60% like Victor, but was not exactly him. The rest of his appearance looked more like Shiva. It was like a profane mixture between the two.
Kali stopped for a moment, looked at the boy’s appearance, and looked at her friend with dangerous eyes: "... Shiva, what did you do?"
"This is my son." He spoke in a neutral tone.
"Why does he look so much like my father? Answer me." Kassandra’s mood, which was already bad, began to fall even further, and this time even Kali did not stop her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1152: Someone from the Bloodline.
paragraphs: "... The reason he looks like the Emperor is because he is his ancestor," Shiva replied. "Victor Elderblood was once a human named Victor Walker, and it is normal for humans to have several generations of beings before them. What I did was simply choose one who was his ancestor and adopt him as my son."

"You made a deal with a Primordial." Kali immediately understood that if someone had the authority to tamper with the Akashic Records and retrieve someone who had already been dead for years, that someone was The Primordials. Considering that Shiva only has souls as something valuable to these beings, the Primordial he made a deal with was The Judge of Abyss.

If this Primordial was convinced to work with other Primordials... It becomes obvious that such a thing was possible. At least, Kali thinks so. She was not as knowledgeable about the matter as her husband or Empress Violet.
"Exactly." Shiva nodded. For this deal, he had to give away many souls he had in stock.
"You tried to create another irregularity like my husband." Kali accused.

"No." Shiva denied with a flat face. "I tried to create someone who had at least 20% of his talent. Even if he only had 10% of the Emperor’s talent and potential, I would be happy. I wanted a warrior, and therefore, I used a ritual that would adopt him as my blood, making him a demigod."
"The Imperial Princesses proved that his talent could be passed down, so that was what I was trying to do," Shiva said.

Honestly, he was a little envious of Victor. How could he have so many talented children? He did not know how many children he had, but just those who appeared in the Empire were all overflowing with latent potential. It was like looking at a bunch of raw jewels parading in front of him, and he could do nothing about it. It was frustrating.
If he took just one of these children for the pantheon, the future would be bright... Or, realistically speaking, the pantheon would disappear under the wrath of many angry dragons.
"But unfortunately." He looked at the boy: "He is not what I expected, but since I brought him back, I would not abandon him, and here we are."
"Here we are indeed." Kali felt her headache return. Sometimes, she thought Shiva could be as bad as Indra. Did he not think this would offend the Emperor?

Even if there were a possible chance that this would not offend the Emperor, this action would definitely offend his daughters, or even his more obsessed wives. Just look at Kassandra now: she was staring at the boy with a deadly gaze. If she were not holding her back, the boy would already have turned to dust, and she was certain that she would not stop at just the boy.

Just because he looked like her father was already a huge offense to Kassandra. Now, he looked like her father and had the appearance of the man in front of her becoming even worse than an offense. It was an existential affront to her. The boy’s existence filled her with profound disgust.
[Victor, I need you here.] Kali did not know how to deal with this, so she simply called Victor himself.
[I am on my way.]

The atmosphere visibly dropped, ignoring all barriers as if they did not even exist. Victor descended here personally. Not a projection of him, but the Emperor himself in flesh and blood entered Shiva’s temple.
When Victor’s immense presence descended, everyone in the pantheon felt it. He was not trying to hide himself, after all.
"Lord Shiva!!!" The gods came running into the temple, looking at the man with long hair made of pure miasma, his eyes glowing crimson-violet with fear.
"Leave."
"But-."
"I said, leave." He spoke more forcefully.
"..." The gods swallowed hard and nodded.
The first thing Victor did upon arriving was caress his daughter’s head and calm her emotions.
"Father..." She grumbled. She said nothing and simply pointed at the boy.
"I know, my dear. I know." He smiled gently.
"Mm..." She hugged him and acted spoiled while smiling gently.

Kali rolled her eyes. ’It is always like this. He only needs to arrive, and they all become spoiled children again.’ She was already used to these things since practically all the daughters seemed to be born with the same brain process: father first, mother second, and the rest did not exist if her father did not say they existed.

Kali would not deny it; she felt a little envious of this. She wanted her daughter to act like that with her too: ’I was the one who carried you in my belly for years! Your father didn’t have to deal with that! It’s unfair.’ She grumbled.
"Stay with your mother," Victor ordered.
"Mm." And like a duckling following obediently after their parent, she immediately obeyed and stayed beside her mother while her eyes stared at her father as if nothing else existed.

When Victor looked at the boy, his eyes immediately activated, and he saw all his truth: his past, present, and future. "I understand, and I think I would have ancestors in ancient England." He saw that the boy in front of him had lived around 1760, right at the beginning of England’s Industrial Age.

His name was Veylan Valentin Walker, a hardworking man who did everything to give his family a better life. Looking at his life, he realized that he and his ancestor had quite a few similarities, both in the way they acted and in the way they thought. Many things were different, which was obvious. After all, they were not the same, but his central motivation was quite similar to Victor’s.
’Died at 76 after moving to the United States, huh.’ After finishing seeing his ancestor’s life, he looked gently at the frightened boy and spoke:
"You lived a long life, boy."
"... Huh? What do you mean, sir?"

And just those words gave Victor everything he needed to understand what was happening to him. ’I understand, they copied the records when he was young, so he has no memories.’ Instead of calling this boy his ancestor, the more correct thing to say was that he was the exact copy of his ancestor retrieved from the Akashic Records. His ancestor had already been dead for a long time.
’Interesting, even the Primordial cannot do something that I did with Hana. This will be useful.’ Victor thought.
Victor did not answer. He simply knelt down and caressed the boy’s head, and smiled gently at him.
"..." Looking at a face so similar to his own and seeing his actions, somehow, he felt very comfortable.
’Is he my father?’ The boy thought, and these thoughts almost made Kassandra destroy him right there.
’My father doesn’t have any sons!!! Don’t get ahead of yourself, boy!!!’ Kassandra clenched her fists angrily.
[Quiet.] Kali ordered her daughter.
[Ugh.] Kassandra grumbled.
"You were deceived in this deal, Shiva."

"Well, technically, you weren’t deceived. You must have asked, I want Victor’s Ancestor or something like that. You should have made the sentence more specific. This boy is indeed my ancestor, but he is only his record. It is like a set of data brought into reality and molded with your divinity. He is not truly present here."
"Look, regardless of which ancestor of mine he is, he would have to have some kind of talent for combat. This is something I have already understood about my bloodline."

The reason Victor researched his bloodline was that his daughters were far too abnormal. Some were pure anomalies of nature, like Kassandra. Yes, perhaps it was because he was a dragon god, but that did not explain why all his daughters were so talented. After some experiments with Ruby and Aline, he discovered that his human bloodline had something that, with every passing generation, amplified the individual’s potential. It was like the Zenkai boost happening slowly through thousands of years of evolution.

With every generation, an individual of his bloodline would have more potential than the previous one, and the accumulation of this bloodline created an abnormality in Victor: he was born with a blood deficiency, RH Null blood, a very rare blood type, named golden blood.

Technically speaking, Victor should have died young. If he had not been transformed into a Vampire, he would have died as a weak human. Though Victor thought that this would not have happened because if Violet had not transformed him into a Vampire, Leona, his childhood friend, would have transformed him into a Werewolf. One way or another, he would have been transformed into a Progenitor of one of the supernatural races.
This was his ’destiny,’ which was a fixed point in time. The Victor, who was outside the universe, ensured that nothing changed this destiny.

Another discovery was that the predatory blood characteristic was only enhanced by his dragon and vampiric sides. This characteristic had already existed in his bloodline to a lesser degree for a long time. Would this change anything going forward? In fact, no. This was simply Victor discovering more about himself.
"The reason he has no talent at all is because he really isn’t here with his physical body, but only a very realistic counterfeit."

’This is fun. Shiva really surprised me. I never would have thought someone could do this to try to replace me.’ Victor never believed Shiva’s claim that he did not want to create another Victor. He was not that foolish, but this was something to make contingency plans for. He needed to deal with the Akashic Records somehow.
"I understand... That explains everything." Shiva nodded.

"Kali will replace you as Leader of the Pantheon, and when the war begins, you will be on the front lines," Victor spoke in a flat tone, and his expressionless eyes said that this was not a request but an Order. What Shiva did here was already enough reason to cause a war. "This is the only reason I did not take back the knowledge I gave you. You will be on every battlefield, and you will protect the Empire with your body."
’I will make sure you are on every dangerous battlefield.’ Victor was a vengeful being by nature. He would not let this go, and everyone here knew that.

"... Understood, Your Majesty." Shiva did not try to argue about it. In fact, this was quite a light punishment considering that the other side could have killed him, and he was not afraid of fighting.
"As for this boy... Just rest, my ancestor. You have already lived a long and satisfactory life." He gently touched the boy’s head, and then his body slowly began to dissolve into white lights.

As he disappeared, Veylan’s appearance slowly changed into a younger version of Victor. The divinity Shiva had given him left his body as his confused gaze slowly changed into understanding and became heavier with the weight of the age of someone who had died old. With a smile, the boy looked at the man very similar to himself: "Thank you."
"I am the one who should thank you. Without you, I would not be here."
As soon as the boy disappeared, Victor looked at Kali with a neutral and emotionless gaze: "Take care of everything, my wife. And let this not happen again."
"... Understood, my husband."

Between husband and wife, few words were necessary for one to understand the other. Kali knew very well that Victor was not satisfied at all with what had happened. If it were not for his consideration for Kali, Shiva’s punishment would not have been so ’lenient.’ He would have been stripped of his divinity and killed on the spot.
Kali knew very well that she had no other chance. She had to control everything to ensure that nothing like this happened again.
Kassandra quickly separated from her mother and jumped onto her father. She looked at her mother for a few seconds and smiled disdainfully:
[You screwed up, Mom, Kishishishi.] She stuck her tongue out at her.
Veins popped on Kali’s head, and she clenched her fist angrily.
[Respect your mother.] Victor spoke heavily.
[... Yes, Father.] She shuddered and immediately said: [I’m sorry, Mother.]
Kali gave a forced smile. [See you at home, my daughter.]

sentences.text: The reason he looks like the Emperor is because he is his ancestor," Shiva replied.
"Victor Elderblood was once a human named Victor Walker, and it is normal for humans to have several generations of beings before them.
What I did was simply choose one who was his ancestor and adopt him as my son."

"You made a deal with a Primordial." Kali immediately understood that if someone had the authority to tamper with the Akashic Records and retrieve someone who had already been dead for years, that someone was The Primordials.
Considering that Shiva only has souls as something valuable to these beings, the Primordial he made a deal with was The Judge of Abyss.
If this Primordial was convinced to work with other Primordials...
It becomes obvious that such a thing was possible.
At least, Kali thinks so.
She was not as knowledgeable about the matter as her husband or Empress Violet.
"Exactly." Shiva nodded.
For this deal, he had to give away many souls he had in stock.
"You tried to create another irregularity like my husband." Kali accused.
"No." Shiva denied with a flat face.
"I tried to create someone who had at least 20% of his talent.
Even if he only had 10% of the Emperor’s talent and potential, I would be happy.
I wanted a warrior, and therefore, I used a ritual that would adopt him as my blood, making him a demigod."
"The Imperial Princesses proved that his talent could be passed down, so that was what I was trying to do," Shiva said.
Honestly, he was a little envious of Victor.
How could he have so many talented children?
He did not know how many children he had, but just those who appeared in the Empire were all overflowing with latent potential.
It was like looking at a bunch of raw jewels parading in front of him, and he could do nothing about it.
It was frustrating.
If he took just one of these children for the pantheon, the future would be bright...
Or, realistically speaking, the pantheon would disappear under the wrath of many angry dragons.
"But unfortunately." He looked at the boy: "He is not what I expected, but since I brought him back, I would not abandon him, and here we are."
"Here we are indeed." Kali felt her headache return.
Sometimes, she thought Shiva could be as bad as Indra.
Did he not think this would offend the Emperor?
Even if there were a possible chance that this would not offend the Emperor, this action would definitely offend his daughters, or even his more obsessed wives.
Just look at Kassandra now: she was staring at the boy with a deadly gaze.
If she were not holding her back, the boy would already have turned to dust, and she was certain that she would not stop at just the boy.
Just because he looked like her father was already a huge offense to Kassandra.
Now, he looked like her father and had the appearance of the man in front of her becoming even worse than an offense.
It was an existential affront to her.
The boy’s existence filled her with profound disgust.
[Victor, I need you here.] Kali did not know how to deal with this, so she simply called Victor himself.
[I am on my way.]
The atmosphere visibly dropped, ignoring all barriers as if they did not even exist.
Victor descended here personally.
Not a projection of him, but the Emperor himself in flesh and blood entered Shiva’s temple.
When Victor’s immense presence descended, everyone in the pantheon felt it.
He was not trying to hide himself, after all.
"Lord Shiva!!!" The gods came running into the temple, looking at the man with long hair made of pure miasma, his eyes glowing crimson-violet with fear.
"Leave."
"But-."
"I said, leave." He spoke more forcefully.
"..." The gods swallowed hard and nodded.
The first thing Victor did upon arriving was caress his daughter’s head and calm her emotions.
"Father..." She grumbled.
She said nothing and simply pointed at the boy.
"I know, my dear.
I know." He smiled gently.
"Mm..." She hugged him and acted spoiled while smiling gently.
Kali rolled her eyes. ’It is always like this.

He only needs to arrive, and they all become spoiled children again.’ She was already used to these things since practically all the daughters seemed to be born with the same brain process: father first, mother second, and the rest did not exist if her father did not say they existed.
Kali would not deny it; she felt a little envious of this.
She wanted her daughter to act like that with her too: ’I was the one who carried you in my belly for years!
Your father didn’t have to deal with that!
It’s unfair.’ She grumbled.
"Stay with your mother," Victor ordered.
"Mm." And like a duckling following obediently after their parent, she immediately obeyed and stayed beside her mother while her eyes stared at her father as if nothing else existed.
When Victor looked at the boy, his eyes immediately activated, and he saw all his truth: his past, present, and future.
"I understand, and I think I would have ancestors in ancient England." He saw that the boy in front of him had lived around 1760, right at the beginning of England’s Industrial Age.
His name was Veylan Valentin Walker, a hardworking man who did everything to give his family a better life.
Looking at his life, he realized that he and his ancestor had quite a few similarities, both in the way they acted and in the way they thought.
Many things were different, which was obvious.
After all, they were not the same, but his central motivation was quite similar to Victor’s.
’Died at 76 after moving to the United States, huh.’ After finishing seeing his ancestor’s life, he looked gently at the frightened boy and spoke:
"You lived a long life, boy."
Huh?
What do you mean, sir?"

And just those words gave Victor everything he needed to understand what was happening to him. ’I understand, they copied the records when he was young, so he has no memories.’ Instead of calling this boy his ancestor, the more correct thing to say was that he was the exact copy of his ancestor retrieved from the Akashic Records.
His ancestor had already been dead for a long time.
’Interesting, even the Primordial cannot do something that I did with Hana.
This will be useful.’ Victor thought.
Victor did not answer.
He simply knelt down and caressed the boy’s head, and smiled gently at him.
"..." Looking at a face so similar to his own and seeing his actions, somehow, he felt very comfortable.
’Is he my father?’ The boy thought, and these thoughts almost made Kassandra destroy him right there.
’My father doesn’t have any sons!!!
Don’t get ahead of yourself, boy!!!’ Kassandra clenched her fists angrily.
[Quiet.] Kali ordered her daughter.
[Ugh.] Kassandra grumbled.

Huh?"

You must have asked, I want Victor’s Ancestor or something like that.
You should have made the sentence more specific.
This boy is indeed my ancestor, but he is only his record.
It is like a set of data brought into reality and molded with your divinity.
He is not truly present here."
"Look, regardless of which ancestor of mine he is, he would have to have some kind of talent for combat.
This is something I have already understood about my bloodline."
The reason Victor researched his bloodline was that his daughters were far too abnormal.
Some were pure anomalies of nature, like Kassandra.
Yes, perhaps it was because he was a dragon god, but that did not explain why all his daughters were so talented.
After some experiments with Ruby and Aline, he discovered that his human bloodline had something that, with every passing generation, amplified the individual’s potential.
It was like the Zenkai boost happening slowly through thousands of years of evolution.

paragraphs: Several hours passed, and all that could be heard from Shiva’s temple were explosions made from immense amounts of the energy of Destruction and Shiva’s screams.

"That’s right! That’s how you should feel!" Rudra, a close friend of Shiva, was jumping and celebrating. He didn’t know what Shiva was going through, but it was certainly something terrible, and for Rudra that was more than enough.
"Hmm, Lord Rudra, aren’t you a friend of His Majesty...?" A god asked cautiously.

"Yes, but do you know how much this ungrateful friend is making me work!? The Pantheon is gigantic, but he keeps giving things to me. I barely have time to see my wife!!!" This was the fury of the working class!
Rudra almost abandoned the Pantheon and went to the Empire because of so much work. At least in the Empire, he would be valued as a competent worker. Here, he only receives more work!

But he didn’t do that because he was Shiva’s friend, and he didn’t want to leave his friend alone, and because this place was his home. Despite his complaints, Rudra enjoyed immense privileges, since he was practically second in command.
"Hmm, shouldn’t you help His Majesty?"
"... How?" He asked a simple question.
"... Well..." The gods didn’t know how to answer such a simple question.
"The one inside right now is the dragon goddess of destruction, Kali. She isn’t just someone of high status in the Empire: she is Kali. You know? That Kali!"

There is a reason why the goddess Kali, despite being so beautiful and powerful, couldn’t get a husband before the Dragon Emperor. She was simply too powerful. Her immense power destroyed a being just by approaching them. She was an untouchable existence in the Pantheon, and not even the former god-king dared to provoke her. Nowadays, she has become even more untouchable.
"I’m also not worried because the one beating him is Kali. She is Shiva’s friend, so she will beat him until he becomes another unknown being, but she won’t kill him."

’And to be completely honest, Shiva deserves this beating.’ Rudra, as the second-in-command, knew exactly what his friend was doing, and even after several warnings, he refused to listen. Therefore, the fault was entirely his.
"Let His Majesty pass, make way!"
The gods began making way for Parvati to pass. When she got close to Rudra, she asked:
"What happened?"
"The obvious happened."
"... Ah." Parvati put her hand on her forehead in frustration. "I warned him, I warned him thousands of times."
"I know, I understand very well." He sighed. When he saw her walking toward the temple, he warned:
"I suggest you don’t enter until the beating is over, Lady Kali is very irritated right now."
"... You’re right."

After completely venting her frustration, Kali returned to her usual apparent serenity. She looked at Shiva, who was lying face down at the bottom of a crater, with his left leg bent and his arm extended, in a certain classic death pose.
The wounds he suffered were already healing, after all, Kali did not beat him with the intention of killing him. She only beat him with the intention of making it hurt.
"Are you stupid, Shiva?" Kali’s tone was so emotionless that it could freeze ice itself.
Shiva opened his eyes and carefully got up from the ground: "Ouch, ouch, my back, ugh."
Feeling Kali’s irritation growing again, he quickly responded:
"Look, I have my reasons for this. I just wanted an exceptional warrior!"
"Stop this nonsense. Do you think everyone here is stupid? You wanted to create another Victor. It’s so obvious that your excuse is pathetic."

Her eyes darkened, and her power exploded, destroying everything around her: "And now, my husband is angry with me!!!" Just because Kali didn’t show much, that didn’t mean she wasn’t similar to Victor’s wives or his daughters; the level of Yandere just varies from person to person.

Normally, Kali was very understanding like Jeanne, but there was a reason why Kassandra was born so unbalanced, and it wasn’t only Victor’s fault. When Kali was irritated, she could be much worse than Violet on her normal days.
Becoming even more irritated, Kali was about to start beating Shiva again, but she stopped when she felt someone approaching.
"... I knew this would happen; I warned that this would happen." Parvati, who appeared after the beating, said the first thing that anyone who made a mistake hates: I warned you.
"See, I told you. You didn’t listen to me as always." Parvati wasn’t feeling sorry for him. She had already warned many times that this was a horrible idea.
"My wife, this isn’t the time for this." Shiva smiled bitterly.
"No, this is definitely the time for this!" Parvati was angry too: "I warned you! Several times, but no, I’m the oldest god of destruction, I’m the wisest, blah, blah!" She exploded.
"You never listen!!! You already have countless examples of what happened to those who challenge the Emperor. Why did you insist on this? Are you Indra 2.0?"
"Cough." Shiva genuinely suffered emotional damage from being compared to Indra.

’Okay, maybe I got a little carried away, but I have a reason: the Emperor is becoming very strong and creating enormous armies!’ Any ally or ruler in this situation would want to have a card up their sleeve. The problem is when you get caught doing it.
What Shiva did he didn’t believe was technically wrong, as he was just preparing for the future. If he had known the sensitive information about the enemy beforehand, he wouldn’t have done this!
’... Son of a bitch! That was the reason he didn’t tell me, wasn’t it? He wanted to see the reaction of his allies, that fox!!!’ Shiva immediately understood what Victor had done.
"What is your punishment?" Parvati asked.
"Fight on the front line of the war," Shiva answered.

"A mild punishment." In this regard, Parvati had complete confidence in her husband. For any other being, this would be a very cruel punishment, which is practically a death sentence, but not for Shiva: he wasn’t weak. "You will train, you will surpass your peak, and when the war begins, I want you to be the one who contributed the most to it. I want to see entire planets of enemies burning, understood? Show me the supposedly strongest god of destruction I fell in love with."
"Yes." He spoke seriously.
"And you will help me pass the command of the pantheon to me, and I will organize everything to my liking so that this never happens again," Kali spoke.

"... Yes." He didn’t really want to, but the fact that Kali would take his position was at least something positive. He didn’t really like the position of God King; it was too much work. He only wanted to relax with his friend Rudra.
And he knew that the Pantheon with Kali in command would be safe. Just look at Aphrodite- she practically remade the Greek Pantheon on a planet.
’Although it is a pantheon that doesn’t have male gods...’ Shiva felt a little envious of Victor, since he basically had an entire pantheon of women for himself.

Shiva sighed. He wasn’t satisfied with what happened. He had even asked the Primordial to help hide the child, but the child still appeared in Victor’s daughter’s field of vision. He was simply unlucky. ’But maybe this isn’t so bad. After all, I really am better at fighting than governing.’ He tried to come to terms with the current situation.
After leaving his daughter at home after pampering her a lot, Victor returned to the ritual: "Increase the budget for the goddess of luck, Tyche."
"Yes, Darling," Natalia spoke and then began to work.

Once again, this incident proved that luck really was a power that he must have on his side at any cost. It is worth noting that Victor was not at all happy about having failures in his information network. The moment Shiva made the deal, he should have already known.

But Victor was not completely dissatisfied, as he already knew that certain powers could ignore his vigilance, especially powers that come from the Primordials. It was impossible to remain completely protected from all angles, after all, his Empire was gigantic. And this incident wasn’t completely bad. He finally had a reason to take the Pantheon for himself and put it under his complete influence.
"Darling, when will you marry Tyche?" Violet spoke.
"... Excuse me?" He looked at Violet sitting on the huge sofa. She was looking at her nails with a bored expression.
"Luck is a very useful power. You should have married her a long time ago, why didn’t you?"

’Even if you ask me that, I have no way to answer. I simply never married her because I didn’t want to, and there was no need?’ Victor could count on his fingers how many times he had interacted with Tyche.

"This is a security breach. You must ensure that this power doesn’t fall into anyone’s hands, and what if Tyche falls in love with someone? With the power she has now, she can practically bend reality so that something is favorable to her target of affection."
Victor remembered his Japanese subordinate who was called lucky, but suffered more than anything. He had some doubts that the sponsor of that man was a goddess from the higher sectors.
"She is right, Darling, you should have a date with her or something, to see how things go," Jeanne spoke.
Putting aside the thought of his subordinate, Victor answered: "Well, let’s see how things go."
"This kind of emotionless attitude is not good!!! You must have her for yourself! I know you don’t want to have more wives, but it’s too late to stop now. Let’s add her to the collection!"
"...." Natalia, Victor, and Jeanne were simply speechless at Violet’s attitude of collecting them all.

"I will prepare a trap - Cough, a romantic situation for you to impregnate her and have her for yourself! Wait for good news!!!" Violet disappeared. "I can’t wait to hold another daughter in my arms!"
"My wives..."
"Yes, my husband." Natalia and Jeanne spoke at the same time.
"Just what did Violet eat for her to act like this? Wasn’t she supposed to be the most obsessed of you?"
"..." The most obsessed one is you, but you are right." The two answered in unison.
"...." Victor ended up being burned for no reason. Okay, it wasn’t for no reason, but that wasn’t the point!

Victor decided to put this aside. It’s not like this was something bad. And, just like all his wives, he will take good care of Tyche. That is, if she accepts becoming his wife. Just as he told Violet, he doesn’t want more wives. After all, if he counts his daughters in the future, the number will already pass 100, but what she said is logical: Tyche’s power of luck must be in the family.

Victor was not blind to his daughters’ feelings. They are dragon goddesses, and the pantheons already tell the story that everyone knows. This is quite normal. He won’t leave his beautiful daughters for other men either. He was too possessive for that. Therefore, such a conclusion was predictable, but he also won’t rush this. He still wants to take care of them as his beloved spoiled daughters. If such a thing was going to happen, it would happen naturally.

’Although Metis, Akasha, and Melida have been making suspicious moves lately, they must have been provoked by Nero and Ophis.’ Victor could investigate and know immediately what was happening, but not knowing everything when it wasn’t necessary was understandable.

Although he already had an idea of what was happening, after all, it hadn’t been long since he slept with Ophis and Nero. Considering that they are his ’daughters’ too. Their actions are quite predictable.
’Well, there’s no point in thinking about it.’ If something happens, it will happen, and it’s not as if Victor would reject the advances of his beloved daughters.

"And you will help me pass the command of the pantheon to me, and I will organize everything to my liking so that this never happens again," Kali spoke.
Yes." He didn’t really want to, but the fact that Kali would take his position was at least something positive.
He didn’t really like the position of God King; it was too much work.
He only wanted to relax with his friend Rudra.
And he knew that the Pantheon with Kali in command would be safe.
Just look at Aphrodite- she practically remade the Greek Pantheon on a planet.

Shiva sighed.
He wasn’t satisfied with what happened.

He was simply unlucky. ’But maybe this isn’t so bad.
After all, I really am better at fighting than governing.’ He tried to come to terms with the current situation.

Once again, this incident proved that luck really was a power that he must have on his side at any cost.
It is worth noting that Victor was not at all happy about having failures in his information network.
The moment Shiva made the deal, he should have already known.

It was impossible to remain completely protected from all angles, after all, his Empire was gigantic.
And this incident wasn’t completely bad.
He finally had a reason to take the Pantheon for himself and put it under his complete influence.

Excuse me?" He looked at Violet sitting on the huge sofa.

You must ensure that this power doesn’t fall into anyone’s hands, and what if Tyche falls in love with someone?

Putting aside the thought of his subordinate, Victor answered: "Well, let’s see how things go."
"This kind of emotionless attitude is not good!!!
You must have her for yourself!
I know you don’t want to have more wives, but it’s too late to stop now.
Let’s add her to the collection!"
"...." Natalia, Victor, and Jeanne were simply speechless at Violet’s attitude of collecting them all.
"I will prepare a trap - Cough, a romantic situation for you to impregnate her and have her for yourself!
Wait for good news!!!" Violet disappeared.
"I can’t wait to hold another daughter in my arms!"
"My wives..."
"Yes, my husband." Natalia and Jeanne spoke at the same time.
"Just what did Violet eat for her to act like this?
Wasn’t she supposed to be the most obsessed of you?"
"..." The most obsessed one is you, but you are right." The two answered in unison.

Okay, it wasn’t for no reason, but that wasn’t the point!

This is quite normal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1154: Tyche, the Goddess of Luck.
paragraphs: After speaking with Victor, Violet immediately put her plan into practice. An Empress did not waste time.
At Tyche’s temple, on the Megaplanet managed by Aphrodite and the ancient Greek goddesses, Violet was sitting on a cozy red sofa, and in front of her was the goddess of luck herself.

"So Tyche..." Violet glanced slyly at the goddess. She was tall, standing at 180 cm, with long brown hair that went all the way to the floor, and her eyes were covered by a white blindfold, while she wore a pure white dress. If you looked at her from afar, she looked like the personification of purity instead of the goddess of luck. She was neither very thin nor very curvy, just perfectly balanced.
"How have things been going?"

"I am doing well, and things are great," Tyche answered gently. She gave off the same feeling as if you were talking to Hestia, the feeling of an older sister or even a mother. "And you, Your Majesty, how are you?"

’Honestly, why wasn’t she one of his wives?’ Violet might have been joking before, but this time, she was genuinely perplexed. How could a woman like this, and of such importance in the Empire, still not be a sister of hers? She was basically a super important goddess in the Empire and with a lot of influence, but basically a free spirit. This was a serious security problem!
Is the author okay? Did he forget? He did, didn’t he? [A/N: Cough.]
Quickly fixing the wall that she had accidentally almost broken, she answered: "Busy as always, and just call me Violet when we’re alone."
"Understood, Lady Violet."
Violet’s violet eyes shone slightly: "Violet. Just, Violet."
"... Understood, Violet." She answered with difficulty.
’What does the Empress want with me? Will she finally add me to the family?’ Tyche was more or less expecting this outcome.

Tyche wasn’t a fool either. She was the daughter of two titans, the goddess of fortune, and a goddess who survived Zeus’s claws during his reign. A foolish God King who didn’t know how to recognize her value, and because of this, she remained completely free.

Unlike most of her companions, she was wiser, sensing her own misfortune from staying close to the new God King. She quickly isolated herself to escape the problems of Olympus, and it turned out that this was the best decision possible.

Even while being far away, she followed Zeus’s ’adventures’ and was very happy to be far away from that abomination. As a goddess, she didn’t have a sense of morality like humans, but even to her, some of Zeus’s actions were absurd, and his brothers and children weren’t much better.

Therefore, unlike the foolish women of Olympus, she stayed as far away from him as possible. In a way, she was like Hecate, who isolated herself in the Greek underworld because she didn’t want to deal with Zeus’s nonsense.

Thanks to this decision, when the invasion of Olympus happened, she was one of those who survived. Now, she had evolved to a status that was much greater than her parents had ever been. She was almost becoming the personification of luck, her power becoming so absurd that reality itself refused to harm her. This power was also a nuisance because it greatly affected her vision, as without this blindfold that was capable of sealing her power, which was made by Velnorah and Aline, she could see the probability of everything. It was something that gave her a lot of headaches. This blindfold design was one that she chose herself, but Velnorah wasn’t satisfied, since she preferred something more like an earring or bracelet. But Tyche thought the blindfold over her eyes gave her more charm, so she chose it.

Her power was like seeing different potential possibilities just by looking at something, and choosing which possibility she wanted to come true at that same instant. This power was something she awakened when her divine concept became much stronger than before. From a minor goddess, daughter of two titans, to a goddess who almost personifies her own concept, Tyche rose greatly in life, all because of the attention of the new God King she serves. Or would it be more accurate to say God Emperor?

"What do you think of the Emperor?" Violet wasn’t one to beat around the bush if it wasn’t necessary, and she knew that the goddess in front of her wasn’t a fool. She should know more or less why she was here.

"A competent ruler, much better than my old one," Tyche answered without even thinking. The mere fact that he recognized her value already placed him above everyone. After all, luck is a completely broken power that can even break fate if necessary. "The old one was complete trash compared to him, just utter incompetent trash. Actually, he was worse than trash, he was a worm! Wait, that’s disrespectful to wormkind itself! Even a worm has more dignity than him!"

Even while following things from afar, that didn’t mean she didn’t hate Zeus and his brothers for what they did to her countless sisters, mother, and father. In fact, it could be said that she harbored complete hostility toward them. It was a shame she had been only a minor goddess before and didn’t have the power to do anything, as, if Zeus were alive now, she would have volunteered herself to be his own executioner. Although she had a suspicion that she would have had to get in line, as the number of beings who wanted to harm Zeus, his brothers, and children was not small.
’So much hatred... I like it.’ Violet thought.
"Hmm..." Violet opened the fan she was holding and positioned it in front of her, slightly below her eyes. Looking at Tyche’s face, she smiled in satisfaction.

As a dragon goddess, a mere tool to seal her power would not prevent her from seeing the other woman’s face. The face of pure contempt and hatred she had was beautiful. ’She will be a good Yandere.’ Violet evaluated, completely satisfied. In the family, everyone was Yandere to some degree: it was tradition at this point. In fact, the family wouldn’t trust a family member who wasn’t Yandere, that was how normal it was.

Just thinking about that walking pig shit made Tyche’s long brown hair that reached all the way to the floor float with the pure rage she felt. Fortunately, in the new Empire, her family was completely fine, and that calmed her nerves a little, but there was a reason for the saying that hell hath no fury like a woman scorned. Tyche endured a lot in silence because she had no power, and now that she had power, her targets were dead or were slaves, and she had no outlet for these emotions. Add that to the fact that she had been single for a long time and was completely frustrated; she was like a bomb about to explode.
"What do you think of Victor?" Violet narrowed her eyes.

As an intelligent woman, she understood what Violet meant: the first question was about the Emperor himself, while the second question was about the man himself. Tyche could make up many things, or even use her power to give an answer with perfect probability, but she felt that it wasn’t necessary to use her powers for such things, so she decided to just be honest.
"About Victor himself, huh... I really don’t know." She shrugged.
"Oh?... Continue." Violet’s eyes shone with amusement as she closed the fan and displayed a small, curious smile.

"I mean, I really don’t know him. I’ve only seen him a few times from afar and heard what his wives say about him, but I really don’t know him. Every time we met, it was in a formal environment. I know the Emperor more than Victor." She pouted, not satisfied at all. There was a reason why she never tried to find some god to be with.

Her main reasons were: First, she wasn’t stupid. With the position she has now, if she got involved with another man who wasn’t the Emperor, her position would be at risk, and her own power even warned her of this. Second, there was already a superior man nearby, who was also the living personification of beauty, and at the same time had almost no flaws regarding his attitude toward how he treated his family. Yes, the fact that he had many wives was an impediment at first glance, but when she really tried to understand the family situation of all his wives, she realized that none of his wives were dissatisfied.

In fact, they were more than satisfied with their situation. They were so satisfied that it made all the attendants who worked with Victor’s wives jealous. With this knowledge, how could she settle for mediocrity? There was already a perfect partner nearby, and a partner who elevated her to the status she had now. Tyche was very grateful to Victor, as if it weren’t for him, she would still be a powerless minor goddess.

’Am I not a beautiful goddess? Why didn’t he go after me? I could go after him, but I am a coward.’ Tyche sighed mentally. She was afraid to try to go after the Emperor and have to deal with several angry dragon goddesses. They were horrifying when they were angry, and therefore, she just stayed quiet in this delicate situation.
"... That’s an honest assessment," Violet said.
Tyche just shrugged.
’Honestly, Darling. What are you doing!?’ Violet genuinely wanted to strangle her husband now.
[In my defense, you know how busy I am?] Violet heard Victor’s voice.
[Even using my time powers for everything, I still have to deal with my adorable wives, daughters, future projects, the ritual, and future plans on the scale of several galaxies.]

The Emperor didn’t do small things, and most of his work was delegated to competent people and his competent wives. Even so, he was always busy, and if it weren’t for the power of time and for not needing to sleep, he would almost have no chance to spend time with his wives and daughters.
[Darling, you’re here!?] Violet was surprised.
[I was curious about it.] Victor’s image in his normal size appeared behind Violet, and he looked at the goddess of luck with curiosity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1155: Tyche, the Goddess of Luck. 2
paragraphs: [Continue, don’t mind my presence here.] Victor spoke.

If Victor so wished, no one would be able to see him. In fact, if he didn’t allow it, no mortal would be capable of understanding what they were looking at when they saw Victor, as he had become a being completely outside common sense.

If he didn’t control his presence, appearing in front of a mortal would only make that same mortal explode, or die from information overload. It was like a being from a higher dimension visiting a being from a lower dimension, and this effect would be even more horrible if Victor and his daughter Yog-Sothoth were in their Eldritch form. The same fact applied to his wives and his daughters, as all of them were beyond common sense.

Although Tyche wasn’t exactly weak, she was the being closest to a primordial of luck in the universe, and therefore, she should also fit into this category. However, she still wasn’t as absurd as a True Dragon. This lineage was simply extremely compatible with existence as a whole. Using numbers as an example: if Tyche’s existence now were a level 10 being, a True Dragon God with her power would be 11, just like Aphrodite, Anna, and Scathach.

Like most of Victor’s wives and some of his more abnormal daughters, such as Kassandra and her mother Kali, all his daughters eventually reached this level, as they all had enormous powers. The most absurd beings, such as Victor, Jeanne, Azathoth, and Yog-Sothoth, Victor’s and Azathoth’s daughter, are the equivalent of number 12 in terms of existence.

Victor predicts that the next level, 13, would be where the primordials are, and level 14 would be the level of the creator, but these numbers mean nothing. They’re just a way to explain, in numerical terms, how absurd his existence is now. Despite the difference being only one number, the distance between the two is like heaven and earth.
"Tyche, you know why I’m here, right?"

"... I wouldn’t be presumptuous enough to try to understand the Empress’s movements." First rule to survive in an Empire of Gods: stroke the Empress’s ego. At least this worked with Hera, but she was stupid and had a horn that was creating its own cosmos in her head, a horn given by her own husband. Violet wasn’t stupid, but even so, it was better not to be too arrogant and to stroke her ego a little.
"..." Violet’s smile froze a little. This conversation wasn’t going according to her plan, ’she’s very humble!’ Violet thought.
[Don’t use your powers to see the future.] Victor spoke with a smile on his face, visibly entertained.
[Tsk.] Violet restrained herself from pouting. If her cat-and-mouse games didn’t work, she decided to be completely honest as she assumed a serious posture.
"Tyche, I came here to say that you should get pregnant and give me a daughter."
[You were too honest! Look at her; she’s getting paler and paler.] Victor slapped his hand over his face.
[Damn it, that’s not what I wanted to say! Actually, it was that, but it wasn’t what I should say!] Violet panicked a little.

"W-Well, if the Empress orders." Her voice faltered, but soon she assumed a strong posture: "Although I don’t enjoy games between women, for the Empire I will do my best." In the end, her voice was practically almost dead.
"That’s not it! I mean, it is, but it’s not that! I came here to say that you should become Victor’s wife."
"Umu, that’s it!" She nodded, satisfied.
"... Ah, that’s it." Tyche sighed, visibly relieved. She was Greek, but unlike her more uninhibited relatives, she was very normal. Thank you very much, as she very much preferred men.
"That’s it? Just that? You don’t seem very surprised."

"Please, Lady Violet, I know my limitations. In this Empire, if I want to maintain my power as it is now, I can only be the Emperor’s wife. That’s why I didn’t accept the proposals of other men. I’m not stupid." Tyche was completely honest. Now that she was going to become the Emperor’s wife, she should develop her relationship with the Empress. In any harem, there are factions, and the safest faction to be in was the Empress’s faction, or the women who had been with the Emperor since the beginning.

’If I’m not mistaken, the names of the closest women are: Lady Anna: the Empress of internal affairs, who will replace Violet if she is unavailable, Lady Leona: his childhood friend, Lady Kaguya: Violet’s Maid, Lady Ruby: the leader of the scientific side along with Lady Aline and Lady Velnorah, and Sasha: in charge of the police of the entire Empire. There is also Lady Scathach... But she is very scary.’ Tyche shuddered when she remembered Scathach, she decided to play it safe, stay close to Violet and be friendly with everyone, it was the best way to understand the dynamics of the factions.
’Ah, my head hurts. I don’t like this, can’t I just remain like Lady Hestia?’ She sighed internally with laziness.

Victor, who was seeing all this, only smiled in amusement, as she reminded him of a very lazy but competent Pepper. For now, he decided to just be an observer, but if she was stressing herself over nothing, he would talk to her about it.

There were actually no factions in his harem, as Victor completely prohibited it. They were family, not a bunch of monkeys fighting over power. There were familiarities or cliques: some women got along better with someone who had the same vibe as them, but that was it. In general, they all respected and played with each other, and any friction they had would be resolved in battle, and if the friction was greater, Victor would intervene and punish both.

’Although I don’t think it will be necessary, she is very rational and intelligent, and as soon as she interacts with the others and my daughters, she will understand... My daughters, shit.’ Victor became a little pale when he forgot this small detail. Adding a wife now was a bad idea, after all, his daughters were very unbalanced due to Ophis and Nero’s recent conquests.

"... You are very rational." Violet felt a strange sensation, almost as if she were seeing a rare species. Where did this completely rational goddess who understands things come from? If most gods were like her, there would be no war.
"If I weren’t like this, I wouldn’t have survived the Greek pantheon." She spoke very seriously.

"... Fair." Violet nodded. She quickly made a temporary contract of absolute secrecy with the sensitive information she had learned, a contract similar to the one Albedo, Dun Scaith, Hela, and Ariel had. This contract would be erased when she made a soul marriage with Victor.

Taking the contract, Tyche read it, and it only had one sentence: You will not reveal anything you learn about the Emperor, his family, and everything related to him to anyone who is not a member of the family with the surname.......
When she tried to read the last part, she felt a terrible headache and quickly stopped reading. "What is that?"
"Eldritch language. You will understand later." Violet smiled.

What was written was the name Elderblood, only in Eldritch letters. After all, this surname is unique in the Empire, and only the royal family can use it. paragraphs: "Tyche." Victor smiled gently at the goddess.
"Y-Yes!?"

’By the Emperor, he is so handsome!’ Tyche already knew this fact, but when she looked at him with that gentle face, she felt that this was pure sin in physical form. He could make any being lose themselves just with that face.
"Let’s have a date to talk later. I just have to talk to my beloved wife, she needs to have a sense of boundaries."
"I completely agree with you." She spoke seriously, agreeing with what he said. What the Empress wanted was too much even for a goddess. For her sake, she needed to have a sense of boundaries!
The problem was that Boundaries and Violet didn’t belong together in the dictionary. In fact, they completely hated each other, because Violet had no boundaries.
Victor laughed lightly as she mused. "See you later, my dear." Taking Violet like a kitten, Victor disappeared with her.
When Victor and Violet disappeared, Tyche’s face crumbled.
"Haaaaaaaaaah..." She let out a long sigh that carried all her emotions during this encounter: "That was exhausting!"

"For a second, I thought I was going to die, disappear, or something worse!" She had already heard many stories about the special treatment that the Empire’s criminals received in hell. Lily’s infamy was very well known, and she had even seen some of the ’arts’ that this woman made.

"Thank goodness I was honest; my decision was correct!" As the goddess of luck itself, she had the instinct to make the best possible decisions for herself. Her power had never betrayed her before, always guiding her.
"I need to calm down... I’ll make some tea and wait for the next meeting with my... Fiancé." She blushed slightly.
Technically, she still wasn’t ’married’, therefore, he was her fiancé.
"Should I tell my mother about this?" She murmured to herself. "... It’s better to wait a little." Thinking about her mother’s attitude, she decided to wait a little until everything was right.
’... I wonder when he’ll return.’ She thought after 30 minutes of drinking tea and relaxing.
Appearing in a dungeon, Victor took a whip that didn’t cause damage, but simply caused pain. Instead of becoming afraid, Violet started to get excited when she saw the place he brought her to.
"D-Darling, where did you bring me?" Her voice was clearly more fragile now.
"Don’t worry, I would never hit you with this."
"... Eh? You won’t?" She was disappointed. Perhaps she hadn’t been shameless enough: ’Right, I’ll increase it to 777 million wives!!!’ She thought.
Violet light formed, and Victor took a beautiful necklace with a terrifying function. It made the person unable to become aroused.
Of course, Victor really didn’t need this necklace, since he could do the same with his powers, but on these occasions, presentation mattered a lot.
Just look at Violet, look at how much paler she became when she saw the necklace.
"... No... No, no, no, this is too much, wait! Can we talk about this!"
"Don’t worry, it’s for your own good."
"You’re evil!!! I thought I had destroyed this abomination!"
"My Dear, Velnorah can always make more." He continued smiling as he approached, and Violet took several steps backward.
"I’ll cut Velnorah’s budget in half! She’s making too many useless things!"
"Denied." The Emperor’s word had more weight than the Empress’s.
"Ugh."
Four months later.

After talking deeply with Violet about boundaries, a conversation that ended up bringing the couple even closer and eventually made them go to the bedroom, after all, it was Violet and Victor, and it was obvious that this would happen. Victor even had to create a time bubble because when they started something, it took a long time to finish.
They simply didn’t have another daughter during this time because Victor wished it so, being able to completely control his fertility.

Leaving the bathroom completely clean and in her noble house dress that was entirely black and accentuated her perfect figure, Violet crossed her arms when she saw Victor standing near the window with a cup of coffee in his hand, looking at floating data.

Although 4 months had passed inside the time bubble, not even 2 hours had passed in the outside world. During all the time Victor was with Violet, he was also keeping an eye on the ritual. Due to the improvement in energy control and his superbrain, such things were easy.
"Fine, I’ll keep it at 3 digits only." She spoke with a pout while caressing her butt, which was red.
Victor sighed: "We already talked about this, my dear."

"But, Darling, you have to understand that eventually, it will reach 4 digits, right? After all, we will live forever. Even if some of our daughters who are more obsessed with training, like Siren, don’t want to have children in the future, others will want to."
"I know." Victor wasn’t a fool, he understood this perfectly:
"We’ll talk about it when we get there. About this specific subject, I don’t plan anything. Just as it has been since the beginning, I let things develop naturally."

Since the beginning, this was Victor’s approach to any relationship. Victor had never intended to open a harem, things simply went down this path on their own. Therefore, he didn’t agree with Violet planning to attract more women to the Harem when it wasn’t necessary. Tyche’s case was acceptable considering that she was an important goddess in the Empire, and all the Empire’s power should remain in the family. After all, the Empire was the family business.
He preferred to let things happen naturally, and if it was meant to happen, it would happen. If it didn’t happen, then it didn’t happen. Victor was already very satisfied with his current wives.

Violet pouted: "... But I can arrange dates with the Valkyries, right? They’re still single, you know? Natasha filled their heads with sweet words and, with Rose being added as their commander, it’s natural that they follow afterward, right? After all, they all need to stay together as a family."
Victor remembered the women he once fought alongside: "... Sure."

Violet gently stroked Victor’s back and spoke sweetly, "Hmm, we also have Yuki Snow; my maid deserves affection, you know? Poor thing, Yuki is pitiful, so many years without finding an ideal partner, waiting for someone obvious."
"... Fine."
"We also have some other women who are waiting for your affection, like Niklaus’s daughter."
"... Who?" Victor doesn’t remember her. Searching his memory, he recalled the report about her and even her appearance.
"Ah, her. The girl who revealed herself to be a Snow, huh."
Seeing Victor’s total lack of interest in the girl, she spoke: "... Hmm, it’s better to leave her out."

Violet knew her husband like the palm of her hand. After all, she had pursued him since childhood. There are very few things she doesn’t know about him, and even if she didn’t, she had two secret weapons: Anna and Leona, who saw him grow up more closely. Therefore, she had absolute confidence that she knew everything about Victor. Even though he showed nothing, she easily noticed that he wasn’t interested.
When she spoke of Yuki and the Valkyries, she saw his interest, and as his Empress and administrator of the Harem, she needed to work to ensure everything ran smoothly.
Victor narrowed his eyes: "I know what you’re doing... But I allow it because I have some affection for them, but don’t exaggerate."

’Hmm, the Snow girl was cut, what a shame, I wanted more people from my clan. Could I not have some ancestor from the Snow Clan sleeping somewhere or something like that?’ Violet decided to search for more about this again. She failed before because she wasn’t strong enough, and she definitely had some ancestor out there. She felt a little envious that basically the Fulger had 3 generations of women from the family married to Victor. She wanted something like that too!
If possible, she wanted 7 generations, or even her ancestor, the first Snow, married to her husband. In fact, she wanted her entire clan married to Victor! From the first Snow to the most recent!
"Of course not, Darling~. I have never exaggerated in my life."

"...." Victor simply looked at her with a blank expression. He didn’t even need to say anything in the face of this obviously false statement. He didn’t even need to point out what she had been thinking about a few seconds ago.
"Okay, I exaggerate sometimes..."
"...." Victor’s blank expression practically became a Poker Face emoji now.
"Okay, I exaggerate many times, but that’s not the point now! All my sisters deserve a happy and healthy home! And my ancestors too! Poor things chained to useless men."
"I’ll return to the ritual." He sighed and returned to work.
"Good work, Darling~."
"Don’t exaggerate, or Karma turns around." He warned her.
"Don’t worry, I won’t exaggerate, Darling~." She blatantly lied.
When Victor left, Violet’s smile distorted as she quickly closed herself in a dimension she created, and she laughed a lot: "HAHAHAHAHAHA~."
"Everything went according to plan!" Violet was very satisfied. She was a genius!

"If we take into account my Maid Hilda who recently joined, Tyche, Yuki, the Valkyries Adrasteia, Dorothy, Alexa, Martha, Julieta, Judy, Anrietha, along with Nero, Ophis, Melida, Metis, and Akasha, we’ll have 55! And if each one has daughters, that’ll be 110!!! I did it, I reached three digits!"
"HAHAHAHAHAHAHA~"
"And you know the best part? Most of them will be under my influence, HAHAHAHA~."
Violet continued laughing for 10 whole minutes, and when she finally got tired, she assumed a serious expression:
"I need to give them the good news." Controlling her expression, she returned to their planet, and the moment the daughters felt their mother’s presence, they shouted:

"MOTHER, WHAT DID YOU DO!?" The sound of running footsteps was heard, and Violet stiffened. She had completely forgotten about her daughters! Of course they would know what happened, and for some reason, Violet heard boss music...

"...." She looked expressionlessly at Maria on the piano, Natasha on the flute, Victoria on the violin, Naty also on the piano, with Sasha being the orchestra leader. All of them were playing their instruments while using their powers to give them more impact. The group of chaotic blondes was enjoying the moment.
"Et tu, Victoria?"
"Well, I was invited, and it seemed fun," Victoria said innocently, but she could see that the woman was irritated, just like the others.
"After all, how did this news spread!? I didn’t tell anyone."
"You didn’t need to. Everyone’s Yandere senses exploded at the same time." Kaguya appeared from the shadows along with Nyx and Ruby.
"Ah."
