paragraphs: "You didn’t need to. Everyone’s Yandere senses exploded at the same time." Kaguya appeared from the shadows along with Nyx and Ruby.
"Ah."
"Why are you calling it that, as if it were Spider-Sense?" Ruby couldn’t contain herself and commented.
"But isn’t it really that? Every time Darling meets a woman, we feel something tingling in our minds." Kaguya spoke in a flat tone.
"Well, you’re right... But you don’t need to call it that!" Ruby replied.
"Then, what should we call it?" Kaguya asked.
"Possessive instinct?" Ruby spoke confusedly.
"Isn’t it the same thing?" Kaguya replied.
"A sixth sense then?" Ruby spoke.

"Can this really be called a sixth sense? I have a sixth sense, and it’s not like that." Kaguya spoke: as a dragon goddess related to shadows, her sixth sense is everything related to shadows and darkness. Just as Nyx can use the dark night sky to be everywhere she wants, Kaguya can do the same with her shadows.
There was a reason the two of them were responsible for the Empire’s intelligence, and they were extremely good at it, since their powers were basically tailor-made for it.
"... We’ll keep the name: Yandere sense, then." Ruby sighed.
"It’s better when things are simple to understand." Kaguya nodded, satisfied.
When the group of 40 children appeared, looking at their mother with lifeless eyes, Violet felt a headache coming on.
"Help me here," Violet asked for support.
"Denied." They all spoke at the same time.
"Huh? You’re denying your Empress!?"
"Darling ordered." Nyx displayed an amused smile.
Violet understood that she had fallen into a trap! So that was what he meant about karma!
"... Darling!!!"
[You caused this, dear. Deal with it yourself, fufufufu~, I also forbid Anna from intervening, good luck~]

In terms of authority, all the mothers had it, but there was always that one mother whom everyone obeyed without question. One of them was Anna, as she had absolute authority with the daughters, and the other was Scathach because they had all suffered at her hands at some point.
The first to arrive was, as expected, Yuno, Kaguya and Victor’s daughter.
"Mother, what did you do? What did you do!?"
Next came her own daughter with Victor, Valentina Victor Elderblood:
"Mother, you can’t randomly add sluts! You need to communicate with us!"
"Mother!"
"Mother!"
"Mother!"
Things were getting out of control very quickly, and Violet was becoming more irritated:
"Silence! Even before you were born, I was the one taking care of everything! I have been pursuing Victor since he was little. You can’t decide for me what to do!"
"That only means you’re old; that doesn’t matter now! You can’t do this!!!" Silvia Elderblood, Victor and Sasha’s daughter, spoke.
And if Silvia and Valentina were nearby, of course Rosemary Lavina Elderblood, Ruby and Victor’s daughter, was nearby too. The three of them were like a trio of chaos.
"Mother, you managed to irritate everyone with this childish maneuver!!! You should have talked to everyone, especially me!"
Veins popped on Violet’s head. "I’m not old! And you’re too young for this!" She pointed at Silvia.
"I’m not young!"
"Say that when your body is like your mother’s!" Violet snorted, crossing her arms and showing off her attributes. Without realizing it, she also hit Valentina and Silvia.
"Ugh, damn dragon genes that don’t make me grow already!!!" Rosemary grumbled.
"... I mean, you are quite old," Naty said.
"Not older than the goddesses, of course... Or Jeanne, she is older than everyone here," Maria said.
"Why am I catching strays if I wasn’t even here?" Jeanne, who appeared stealthily, spoke confusedly. "What the hell did I do?"
"Not to mention that I have few memories from that time, so it doesn’t count!"
"Woman, you were alive well before the universe took shape. If you’re not the oldest of us, then I’m a penguin and not a dragon." Maria spoke.
"I mean, Azathoth was alive even before the universe was created, so I’m not the oldest here!"
Now that the mothers thought about it, she was right:
"... Fair point." They all said at the same time.
"Humpf, the discussion about time for beings like us is useless." Azathoth appeared, speaking.
"All hail the Ancient One of the universe." Naty stood up, placed both hands on her dress, and gave a noble’s bow.
"The Ancient One." The others followed Naty’s example.
"..." Veins began popping on Azathoth’s head. "You really can be annoying when you want to."
"Thank you." They all spoke at the same time, smiling.
"That wasn’t a compliment!!!"
"Age doesn’t matter much to us anyway," Kaguya said, shrugging. "So you don’t need to be too offended, sister."
"Humpf, I wouldn’t be offended by such comments. Being older means my wine is more refined, and I wouldn’t create the stupidity that the Empress did."
"... That’s true." The wives nodded in agreement.

During Azathoth and Victor’s activities, sometimes her ’wine’ fell into their mouths, and this ’wine’ had the refined taste of madness and insanity with a slightly spicy aftertaste. It was a very delicious flavor that made the person want to taste it again to fall even deeper into this pit of madness’ perdition.
"Humpf." Azathoth snorted and crossed her arms, showing her attributes.
"Although Jeanne and Gaia’s ’wine’ isn’t bad either, it tastes like nature." She reflected.
"Actually, everyone here tastes good. After all, we are dragon goddesses. It’s just that each one has her own flavor that matches her essence." Naty spoke.
"My family’s has an electrifying flavor, with my mother’s being the strongest, the Snows’ is warmer, and the Scarletts’ is colder." Natasha reflected.
"I’m curious, what is mine?" Maria asked.
"It has a touch of madness, with a bold and restrained flavor," Azathoth answered.
"Interesting... I wonder if we can refine this flavor." Maria spoke.
"I think it depends on our diet," Sasha said.

"But I like to eat Darling’s white ice cream. It’s much tastier than anything, and his blood is also very good." Being True Dragon Goddesses, they are superior beings, so they don’t need to eat to exist. The same applies to sleeping, relieving themselves, etc. They are above these mortal inconveniences.
Jeanne blushed slightly: "Why are we even talking about this? Are you wine sommeliers or something!?"
"..." Azathoth, Sasha, Maria, Naty, and Natasha simply shrugged.
"It’s a subject worth debating. Let’s ask Darling which flavor he likes the most later." Naty spoke.
"Bunch of shameless women!!!" Jeanne snorted. "And Darling won’t answer that; he’ll say that all of them are good!"
"... That’s true." Naty reflected for a few seconds and answered.
"Ah, so I used to be like that. I miss those days." Sasha sighed.
"Fufufu~, I prefer you like this, you’re more of a Fulger now, you’re my pride!" Natasha spoke.
"That’s right, our daughter is amazing." Naty nodded.
"..." Sasha didn’t know how to feel about this pride her two mothers were talking about.

Hearing these comments and being ignored while they enjoyed watching her struggle, Violet grew even more irritated. She lost her patience when a crown appeared on her head. All the daughters simultaneously moved away. This power of Order was no joke.
But suddenly all the power disappeared, and Victor’s voice was heard by everyone:

"Order Power is forbidden, and no aggression will happen here. Talk as mothers and daughters." In his soul territory, Victor was practically omnipotent, omniscient, and omnipresent. He could decide everything here.
"Darling, this isn’t fair!!!" Violet shouted indignantly.
"Good luck, my daughters. I’ll be watching."
Hearing their father’s blessing was like releasing the leash of a pack of wild dragons. Everyone’s eyes immediately shone a pure violet, and they advanced on their mother, asking countless questions.
Looking at that multitude of violet eyes, Violet felt her headache return.
"Hehehe~, that’s what you get for being too sneaky." Maria laughed.
"Who did she add this time?" Sasha asked.
"Tyche," Kaguya answered.
"Ah... Actually, it’s strange that she isn’t our sister considering her position." Sasha nodded.
They all thought about Tyche’s position in the Empire and nodded in agreement, since it was indeed strange.
"Fufufu~, but it wasn’t only Tyche. I heard from reliable sources that she added 8 more sisters." Nyx spoke.
"Eight!?" They were shocked.
"It’s been a long time since that happened, huh? The old batch was Albedo’s group." Ruby spoke.
"Speaking of Albedo, where is she?" Victoria asked.
"Locked up doing experiments with Aline," Ruby answered.
"She should learn to go out more," Natasha said. "It’s not healthy to stay locked up for so long, dragon goddess or not."
"Well, the only one who can really make her leave is Darling," Ruby said.
"...." The group of wives looked at Violet, who was doing her best to control the group of Yanderes, and failing miserably.
"... Should we intervene?" Victoria felt a little sorry.
"No." They all spoke at the same time.
"Let her suffer a little more." Ruby smiled, but her smile didn’t reach her eyes. It is worth noting that she wasn’t satisfied at all with her adding more sisters without contacting her.
"Violet needs to learn not to do things without consulting us, especially something as important as new sisters," Jeanne said, unsatisfied with Violet’s actions as well.
"Which women is she planning to kidnap?" Sasha asked.
"The Valkyries and Yuki Snow." Nyx answered.
"... Valkyries? Finally, it’s their turn." Rose, who appeared along with Eleonor, spoke.
"Looks like their dream of making him like Solomon is progressing." Eleonor laughed.

"To be fair, they really had little contact with Darling due to their position. If it weren’t for that, they would already be our sisters. After all, the taste Victor enjoys the most is that of warrior women." Ruby spoke.
’That’s my mother’s fault.’ She snorted, thinking.

Victor’s taste at the beginning was for Yandere women, thanks to the anime Leona gave Victor to watch. After suffering Stockholm syndrome from Scathach’s training, he began to like warrior women with abs and a strong personality.
The Valkyries fit directly into Victor’s tastes. It was because of this taste that he became interested in Eleonor and Rose.

The Valkyries generally stayed in Eleonor’s territory or under Rose and Eleonor’s command when they went on missions. After the events of the war against the Elder Gods, they had little communication with Victor, and when they met, they briefly talked as comrades. There was never the right moment for the girls to try to seduce Victor.

They even considered kidnapping him and doing things the old-fashioned way, but they feared Eleonor and Rose’s anger, not to mention that they were already too weak at that time to do anything against Victor.
"That’s true," Eleonor said.
"... And when did you appear?" Ruby spoke.
"We felt something was wrong, and we came to check what was happening. Our daughters were chaotic too, and even Akasha isn’t functioning properly now." Rose answered.
"You can expect the other sisters to appear too," Eleonor said.
"She really poked the entire hornet’s nest, huh." Ruby laughed.

"But Yuki, huh... Considering Hilda joined not too long ago." Sasha reflected aloud; she didn’t even need to say anything, but everyone here understood. Violet was clearly trying to bring more members of her Clan to become sisters.
"Humpf, amateur, she’s trying to imitate the Fulger, but she won’t succeed, fufufufufu~" Sasha snorted. "The Snow don’t have any living ancestral women! I win! HAHAHAHAHA~"
The women around her rolled their eyes: ’Not all Clans were a well of madness like yours.’ They thought.
Natasha looked at her daughter with tears falling from her eyes: "They grow up so fast."
Compared to the puritan Sasha from the beginning, this Sasha was much better! ’I successfully corrupted her; it’s my victory!’ Once again, she was proud of her daughter.
"Help me here, damit it! And shut up!" Violet growled.
"No." The mothers and daughters said at the same time.
"Mother, you have to stop being so authoritarian!!! I vote for your dismissal as Empress, let Mother Anna take your place!" Valentina committed the greatest of betrayals at this moment.
"Et tu, my daughter!?"
Valentina was unmoved as she quickly raised the flag: "The tyrant needs to be impeached. All hail Empress Anna!"
"All hail Empress Anna!"
"All hail Empress Anna!"
"Bring down the Tyrant!"
"Bring down the Tyrant!"

paragraphs: A few more years passed within the Ritual, and then it was the 170,000th year of the Empire. Victor finally had a small clue, a clue that he had been searching for since the beginning, when he started the Ritual.
Sagittarius Dwarf Elliptical Galaxy, approximately 80,000 light-years from Yggdrasil. On one of the moons of the planets under the Empire’s control.

"In the beginning, God made man, and man in his arrogance thinks he made God. And in the end, God was killed by man. Now, it is man who wants to be God." The being’s voice echoed through the room. "This happened a long time ago, before you even existed, Nikolai."

"T-The Emperor’s Herald."
Nikolai was shitting himself badly now. He knew that what he was doing would attract the Empire’s attention, but he never thought that the Emperor would send his Herald.

The Emperor’s Herald only moved with his will. No one knew how many there were, and no one had survived to tell stories. Technically, he shouldn’t even know about this information, but his patron was a special being.
War, reborn as the Progenitor of his own race by the Emperor, a race that serves only the Emperor, his strongest Herald.

Normally, for a small fish like him, War didn’t even need to move, only needing to send his subordinates, the other heralds, but this man... This man was worthy of his presence, and of his subordinates. What was inside him made the Emperor himself move.

Under War’s hood, his face, made of pure darkness, looked at the man kneeling in front of him. His mere presence should have driven this man insane from sheer incomprehension of what he was seeing, but he still resisted. And that was precisely why War was here. This man had been touched by the gods of the upper sectors.

"Speak. What were your orders?" His command was like a weight upon reality, forcing him to speak.
"A-Attack the Emperor’s bloodline, clone his blood, understand the mystery of his abnormality, my master wants to know who is-."
"AHHHHHH!" He screamed while holding his head, as black tears fell from his face.

Nikolai coughed violently, and corrupted blood fell onto the floor. War’s presence was slowly driving him insane, and even his existence was beginning to fail both because of War’s presence and because of his master.
Looking at that blood that had a divinity he had never felt before, War understood: ’I understand; that’s what the Emperor saw, huh? The Emperor’s vision never fails,’ he thought.
[My Master.]
[... War.] The Emperor’s voice echoed in his mind.
[Your Majesty was correct.]

War felt the Emperor’s gaze upon him. As his Herald, he was like the Emperor’s eyes, arms, and ears. If the Emperor so desired, he could serve as a vessel for the Emperor himself. Soon his vision changed, and he was able to see more thanks to the Emperor.
[Disgusting creature.] He heard the Emperor’s verdict, and he completely agreed.

In the vision of the Emperor and War, the man’s soul was an amalgamation of several things that were slowly degrading and corrupting him. It was not a corruption like his Eldritch power, but rather a corruption of conceptual degradation. He was slowly dying simply by existing.

’This is similar to the powers of those children of Niklaus, only a much stronger version... I understand, Niklaus had been in contact with them for a long time... Or, he found something left behind by them in this Sector, and used it on his children, and because of this, he attracted the attention of these creatures.’ Victor thought. He knew very well that the gods of the upper world threw various fragments of items into the lower Sectors so that they could influence the lower Sectors and eventually place that Sector under their domain. It was apparently a very common practice.
[Bring it to me.]
A power made of darkness and violet covered Nikolai, and soon he was in ecstasy, as the Emperor literally tore them out of reality and pulled him into another dimension.
[Yes, My Master]

When the Emperor’s presence disappeared, War turned his attention to the man: "Rejoice, Nikolai. In the end, the Emperor is merciful. You will have his mercy by being useful to the Empire one last time."

Grabbing the man by the neck, his subordinates appeared: four beings, two men and two women. Dressed like him, they were wearing hoods, and where their faces were, nothing could be seen, just like their Progenitor.
"Status."
"All captured and delivered to the Third Legion."
"Good."
"What do we do with the installation?"
"Such a place is stained with the intentions of a Heretic. It is unworthy of the Emperor."

In the blink of an eye, the five vanished and appeared far away from the moon. War raised his palm toward the moon and closed his hand. The moon was immediately compressed by an unknown force, and in less than two seconds, a small stone stood in War’s hand. The strange thing was that even when the moon disappeared, there were no problems on the planet below. Such minor problems were unworthy of the Emperor’s Herald. Their level of power and authority was among the strongest, on the same level as some of the Emperor’s strongest wives, being slightly superior thanks to him being an Eldritch being. But such comparisons were useless. War was the Herald handpicked by the Emperor, the Emperor’s will given form.

Erasing the moon completely, War immediately began making another moon identical to the one he erased, and placed it in the same location, exactly identical, as if nothing had changed. "A clean new beginning."

Victor stood up from the Ritual site, and then teleported to a dimension he made at the edges of his Sector. He wasn’t stupid enough to bring a creature touched by foreign gods into his personal world, or anywhere near his family. And therefore, he brought him to a place he could abandon at any moment.

Appearing in a laboratory, Victor began muttering in Draconic and Eldritch language. Runes appeared around him and soon began merging with the surrounding space as he isolated this place from reality as much as possible. He placed several countermeasures in the dimension to prevent anyone from escaping.
He quickly remodeled the laboratory into a place that looked like a sacrificial altar, with a bed made of stone, and soon hundreds of runes began appearing all over it.
War appeared along with his subordinates as they, along with War, immediately knelt before the 5.50-meter-tall Emperor.
"Good Work, my Heralds." Nikolai’s body began to float under Victor’s control, and then he placed him on the stone bed.
"We live to serve."

Words of thanks were not necessary for the Heralds, but Victor never lost this habit that he acquired when he fused with Adonis. Herald or not, important subordinate or not, if the subordinate did a good job at his command, he would thank him. By doing this, he was recognizing the efforts of his subordinates and consequently making them happy. After all, the Heralds were not machines, they were still alive. And this applies to all the Empire’s subordinates.
The proof was right in front of the Emperor, as by simply thanking them, Victor felt the emotions of happiness and purpose overflowing from the heralds.

War looked at the stone bed that had hundreds of runes, and even despite being an Eldritch creature, just by looking at it, he felt the beginning of a headache. It was still bearable, but he probably wouldn’t be able to look at it for long.
’As expected of Your Majesty.’
"...." Victor opened his mouth and spoke only one word, but his subordinates didn’t understand anything. It was as if he had spoken in a completely unknown, inaudible frequency.

The Eldritch language was not strange to them, but when the Emperor spoke, it was as if a being from a higher dimension tried to speak with a being from a lower dimension. Nothing was understood, and given how complex the Ritual was, it was understandable that they didn’t understand anything.
When the Emperor spoke, the runes began to activate, and all the runes written on the stone bed began to move as if they were alive as they entered Nikolai’s body.
Nikolai opened his eyes wide, as well as his mouth, and screamed:
"......" But nothing was heard or understood.
His body began to float, and more and more runes began entering his body, as his existence was being forcibly remodeled for the Emperor’s purposes.
When all the runes entered Nikolai’s body, he plummeted from the air and fell onto the stone. Observing everything with a cold gaze, the Emperor didn’t waste time.
"Rise, filthy creature, I know you are in there."
With his body broken and destroyed, Nikolai... Wrong, it would be more correct to say the creature inside him stood up.
"... Splendid."
The Heralds immediately stood up and spread out around the creature, surrounding it. War stood in front of the Emperor, protecting him.
"You pulled my consciousness from the upper sectors here... You are, without a doubt, the anomaly he talks about so much."

’Tsk, a small fish, waste of time.’ Victor didn’t waste time with useless speech. The moment it fell into his domain, he read the entire existence of the fragment of this God in front of him. They were enemies the moment they planned against his family, and he had no mercy for beings like this.

’A lot of context is missing, as expected. It’s the same as my clones; he isn’t here, and it’s only a piece of his consciousness.’ Victor understood the situation, but even so, he didn’t interrupt him, as there was the slightest chance that he would let something useful slip. That was also the purpose of the runes, as Victor only observed. In any case, he wouldn’t escape from here.

"The newcomer <Chaos>, an anomaly that, even while being in a lower sector, you understand reality so well..." His eyes of pure darkness narrowed, and a smile of happiness was seen: "The owner of <Negativity>."
"You are the spark we were waiting for, the spark for the war for the throne, HAHAHHAHAHA~."
"You have no idea how famous you are, such a great anomaly, <Light> is searching for you like crazy, he wants your Negativity for himself-..."
"Why am I talking so much...? I’m not as talkative as those pigs of <Emperor>."
"... You did something to me... What language is this?" He looked at Victor’s subordinates: "Impossible, beings from beyond Death!? How!?"
"Speak more, don’t stop." Victor’s eyes narrowed.
"Who do you think you’re ordering around? I am-... He wants to kill and absorb you to take the throne for himself, but we won’t let that happen, we will-... Hunt you down and take the power-."
"How? Tell-me."

As far as Victor knew, divine concepts as high in the hierarchy as Negativity or Positivity cannot be absorbed. After all, all other divine concepts literally descend from them. Negativity was responsible for the divine concept that controls spirituality, negative concepts, and abstract concepts. Positivity is responsible for the material world, positive concepts, and concrete concepts. The joining of the two was what formed Chaos, which is literally everything that has already been created and will be created in the future. It is impossible to steal this, you have to be worthy, or at least Victor mistakenly thought so.

One thing is <Light> coming after Victor and taking this from him, since Victor already expected this. After all, Positivity and Negativity were literally one concept divided in two, and it would be completely different if some random person were trying to steal this from the two.
"SPEAK." The entire dimension trembled when the Emperor ordered, as he raised his hand and used his powers to prevent him from escaping.
"I heard that <Darkness>, <Emperor> and <Law> can assu-...."
The body literally exploded along with the soul.

’A soul contract at a very high level, probably an existential level.’ Which means that the entire being of that creature was under the influence of another entity that placed severe limitations on him, but... So what? Such a thing would be the end for a normal being, but the one he was dealing with was the Dragon Emperor. Victor Elderblood.
Victor’s eyes shone: "You will not escape from me."

Victor forced the entire shattered soul to reunite. He used his power of Negativity, Life, BEGIN, time, space, soul, Eldritch, and dragon reality distortion and literally forced time to turn back, along with his soul and body. He combined this with the preparations he’d made beforehand, using the runes and the dimension as a controlled environment. The impossible was done.
’You will not go to the Akashic Record, not until I know everything I want.’
The being began to reconstruct itself, then 30 seconds later, he was there alive again as if nothing had happened.

"Impossible... IMPOSSIBLE! I felt this fragment die, I-... How did you pull my-..." He swallowed hard when he looked at Victor, and all he saw was a thing made of thousands of violet eyes and mouths... His eyes exploded from not understanding what he was seeing.
"SPEAK TO ME!"
Victor’s existence in Emperor form spread throughout the entire dimension as this place became the stomach of an Eldritch God, a shapeless cosmic Horror.
"AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!"
His existence exploded, but this time, he returned almost immediately.
"Speak," Victor commanded, but nothing was understood by him.
The body exploded again, and the next second, he reformed. When he reformed this time, his mind was collapsing, but Victor did not allow it.
"I-..." He died.
He revived.
"I heard rumors that <Darkness> plans to steal-."
He died and was revived immediately afterward. This time, he couldn’t even say anything as his body simply collapsed before the cosmic horror, but he would not have peace.
"No matter how many times you die, I will bring you back."
"Now, speak."

623,596,777,174 deaths later, years passed in there, but Victor didn’t care. Victor learned all the information that this fragment knew, and about the God connected to it. ’Fool, this is why you make a contingency plan in case you can’t escape the body.’ Victor thought disdainfully.

’It’s a shame he is only an elite warrior, and not someone of great importance, only a slightly bigger fish... But it’s good to have more information.’ The Faction Victor understood the most now was the Faction of <Darkness>, a being who contained hundreds of galaxies under his command.

’And with this, I can confirm that the faction that has Niklaus is the one led by <Darkness>.’ Despite being a slightly bigger fish, he gave a lot of useful information because, though he was a little more important, he was competent and paid attention to what was going on around him. He didn’t know details about many things, and much information could not be taken into consideration. After all, they were only the thoughts of the God himself and rumors he heard, but having a general idea of things was already good enough.
’This did not confirm that others can steal my Negativity. He had no concrete facts about it.’ Victor decided to keep his previous thoughts, but always keep an open mind for unforeseen circumstances.
The God who was using Nikolai’s body was also dead from the corruption of extreme contact with a cosmic Horror.
Erasing the dead body with his powers, since he had already gotten everything he wanted from this God, taking the body impregnated with the Eldritch stench would be foolish.
"Come, My Heralds."
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Upon leaving the dimension, Victor completely destroyed it.

paragraphs: With Violet.
"Listen, girls, your mother is wise, and she knows-." Violet stopped speaking. The playfulness left her face, and her expression became completely serious.
"Darling..."
A crown appeared on her head and began to slowly spin. Using her Order powers together with future sight, she searched for the reason Victor was so irritated.
"ANNA!"
"Yes, My Empress."
"Take care of our daughters." Violet turned around and then ordered: "All to your posts."
She looked at Ruby and Sasha: "With me, my sisters." Before disappearing along with Sasha and Ruby. Then, the others vanished after she left, leaving only Kaguya and Nyx behind.
"Ahh, she ran away-."

"Silence," Anna ordered, and as if someone had pressed the mute button on the remote control, everyone fell silent. Those who were not blinded by their feelings quickly realized that something had happened that made all the mothers change.
Anna looked at Kaguya and Nyx, and nodded: "Go, I’ll take care of things here."
"Yes." They did not waste any time and quickly disappeared.
When the mothers stopped playing around, all the other daughters realized that something must have happened.

"..." The wives swallowed hard.

"I will be on the project too," Scathach said. She did not trust that her sisters would control this chaos incarnate.

"Most of the time, I’m free. Don’t worry: I love your company, my daughter."
"That’s not fair!!!"

paragraphs: A woman with long black hair and violet draconic eyes, standing 190 CM tall, with a defined, curvy body and perfectly sculpted 6 pack abs, walked through the castle like an angry supermodel, as if someone owed her money. She wore a modern outfit: two black high heels, black leggings, and a long-sleeved shirt that left her belly exposed. This woman, who looked like a perfect mix of both Anna and Victor, was Stella Elderblood, daughter of the two.
Upon reaching a door more than 10 meters tall, Stella spun and kicked it.
